annotation.title_clean: Guidelines and Companion Guide on Securing AI Systems
annotation.title_en: Guidelines and Companion Guide on Securing AI Systems
annotation.venue: Cyber Security Agency of Singapore website
annotation.summary_en: Singapore Cyber Security Agency landing page presenting its Guidelines on Securing AI Systems and a community-driven, non-prescriptive Companion Guide. They promote secure-by-design and secure-by-default AI across its lifecycle, addressing classical and adversarial machine learning risks, and are maintained as living resources.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI systems should be secure by design and secure by default.
Guidelines help system owners secure AI throughout its lifecycle.
Covers classical risks such as supply chain attacks and novel risks such as adversarial machine learning.
Companion Guide is community-driven and non-prescriptive, referencing MITRE ATLAS and OWASP Top 10.
Documents will be updated as living resources.
